Hormones are produced and secreted by the endocrine glands. They affect your physical, mental and emotional well-being. Hormones also play a role in development, puberty, fertility, and aging. Hormones regulate metabolism, breathing, heart rate, growth, mood, digestion, appetite, sleep, and insulin.

Certain hormones decline with age which is natural. Much can be done with diet, lifestyle, and supplements to ensure optimal health, and graceful aging.

Welcome to Hand Mudras! An easy and inviting way to explore and regularly practice hand Mudras, choosing from a universe of 108 gestures offered.

Each gesture is described carefully and in detail, including:
• clear instructions and image for you to perform each hand gesture with precision; 
• cautions;
• main benefits cultivated by the practice;
• a list of mudras with similar effects.

You have 4 easy ways to access these gestures:
Daily Mudra - the Home screen shows every day a different Mudra image for you to practice.

Index of Mudras - shows a list of all Mudras organized by group families from which you can access and browse the gestures. You can also search for a word or phrase and browse the Mudras related to the phrase.

Gallery - shows all Mudras images organized by group families. You can select Mudras associated with specific Chakras, Elements and Systems.

Practicing Now - you can place here the Mudras you are practicing for quick access and easy control of your regular practice. You can also add to this list a gifted mudra, by clicking in random selection.

As the practice of these mudras are incorporated into your daily life, you naturally begin to experience and share with others a greater sense of integral health and wellbeing !!!
